editorial:
Imagine you are totally broke and suddenly find out you inherited a house from a relative you barely knew. That is exactly where you start with this creepy ride. You follow a woman who is just trying to flip this old place to pay off her bills, but the vibe shifts fast. Instead of a quick payday, you get pulled into a twisted game. The house feels like it is watching her, and as she finds weird clues left behind, you realize she is not just cleaning up a property. She is walking straight into a trap set by her own ancestors. It starts slow, but once the scavenger hunt begins, the tension never lets up.

You will love how the acting feels real and the twists actually surprise you. The pacing is great, though some of the middle parts might feel a bit slow if you want non-stop action. If you love a good mystery that makes you guess until the end, you need to see this. For the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the creepy details in the dark rooms. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the scavenger hunt was actually a ritual to find a new host for a family demon. When you reach the final clue, the main character realizes she was not meant to sell the house, but to replace her ancestor. In the final scene, she tries to burn the place down, but the demon takes over her body anyway. The movie ends with her smiling at the camera, showing she is no longer in control.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves spooky houses and puzzles.
